purpose: Pin the control_response shape of `control_request{subtype:"get_context_usage"}` on a current binary, and the arithmetic relating `categories[]` to `totalTokens` / `rawMaxTokens`.

rawLog.reason: The raw response embeds local memory-file paths, the capturing machine's custom agent + skill inventory, and its MCP server names. This sanitized summary keeps the durable protocol facts without machine-specific material.

noTurnConsumed: The CLI answered on a session that had never received a user message, before any API call. get_context_usage is handled out of band in the stream-json input loop — it consumes no turn and makes no API call, so it is safe to issue mid-turn or idle.

arithmetic.totalTokensDefinition: sum(categories where NOT isDeferred and name not in {'Free space','Autocompact buffer'}) — 4027+15397+105+1424+3067+8 = 24028, exactly the reported totalTokens.
arithmetic.deferredIsExcluded: The 13467-token deferred row is listed but NOT counted. A consumer that naively sums every row overcounts by the deferred total.
arithmetic.nonDeferredRowsTileTheWindow: sum(categories where NOT isDeferred) = 1000000 = rawMaxTokens exactly. 'Free space' is the remainder term, so the non-deferred rows tile the window. Summing ALL rows gives 1013467 — 13467 over the window.
arithmetic.percentageDenominator: round(totalTokens / rawMaxTokens * 100) = round(2.4) = 2. Reported by the CLI; AO displays it rather than recomputing.

omittedFromCapture.gridRows: 10 rows x 20 squares of {color,isFilled,categoryName,tokens,percentage,squareFullness} — a pre-rendered grid for the CLI's terminal UI, derived from `categories`. AO draws its own meter and ignores it.
omittedFromCapture.mcpTools: [] on this capture — [{name,serverName,tokens[,isLoaded]}] when servers are configured.
omittedFromCapture.agents: [{agentType,source,tokens}] — 2 entries; summarised by the 'Custom agents' category row.
omittedFromCapture.skills: {totalSkills,includedSkills,tokens,skillFrontmatter:[{name,source,tokens}]} — 23 frontmatter entries; summarised by the 'Skills' category row.

versionDrift.vs2_1_88: `autocompactSource` and messageBreakdown's `redirectedContextTokens` / `unattributedTokens` are new since the 2.1.88 SDK schema (SDKControlGetContextUsageResponseSchema). Optional-in-schema keys absent on this capture: deferredBuiltinTools, systemTools, systemPromptSections (the latter two are ant-only in the CLI's own /context renderer).
versionDrift.parserPolicy: AO decodes only totalTokens / maxTokens / rawMaxTokens / percentage / model / categories[] and passes category names through verbatim, so new categories and new sibling keys are additive-safe.

conclusion.aoUse: On-demand only, from the context meter's popover. `internal/provider/claude/context_usage.go` (Session.GetContextUsage + ParseContextUsage) -> `GetThreadContextUsage` -> ContextBreakdown.svelte. Never persisted, never polled — the passive message_delta.usage signal still drives the live meter.
